description_en: Retrieves details about service space resource usage
description_zh: 查询服务空间资源用量详情
name: QuerySpaceUsage

parameters.help_en:
The end time in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time.

If the time range is within one day, hourly metering data is returned automatically
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间，UTC。
结束时间必须晚于开始时间。
当时间范围不超过一天时，自动返回小时级别计量数据
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
This field is optional. If omitted, data granularity varies based on the query time span. For spans longer than one day, data is returned daily. For spans of one day or less, data is returned hourly.

The time granularity for query data. Unit: minutes. Valid values:

1440 (returns data daily, for spans up to 31 days).

60 (returns data hourly, for spans up to 7 days).

5 (returns data every five minutes, for spans up to 1 day)
parameters.help_zh:
可选字段。当缺少该字段时根据查询时间跨度返回不同粒度数据。大于一天按天返回，小于等于一天按小时返回。

查询数据的时间粒度。单位：分钟。取值：

1440（按天返回，跨度不超过31天）。

60（按小时返回，跨度不超过7天）。

5（按五分钟返回，跨度不超过1天）
parameters.name: interval
